💪 Build: Stocky Build
Short and solidly built — compact but powerful, with wide shoulders on a shorter frame. Dense and hard to move.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Stocky Build.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Stocky frame — short stature with wide dense build, thick neck, broad shoulders compressed into compact proportions. Heavy and grounded. Female: shoulders broad but level with the hips, short neck, round full jaw, the chest line above a thick short waist. Male: shoulders and neck thick and short, jaw square, a flat wide chest with no taper. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own structure compressed and wide.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
